## Overview

`dsMatching` provides the server-side implementation required to support causal inference workflows in a federated DataSHIELD environment. Paired with the [dsMatchingClient](https://github.com/roygusinow/dsMatchingClient) package, it enables secure, distributed estimation of treatment effects and matching diagnostics without exposing individual-level data.

## Installation

``` r
# Install the server-side package from GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("roygusinow/dsMatching")

# Installing on remote client using OPAL
library(opalr)
o <- opal.login(url = URL, user = USER_NAME, password = PASSWORD)
oadmin.install_github_package(o, "dsMatching", username="roygusinow", ref = "master")
```
